newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill on Monday, USDA said. No sales slaughter steers or heifers. Buyer inquiry limited, few bids of 68.00 live and 109.00-110.00 dressed, but most not bidding, just taking inventory.
Seller interest minimal. Asking prices 70.00 live and 112.00 or more dressed. Last market adequately established on Wednesday (05-07) with live prices 68.00-69.00, dressed prices 110.00-112.00.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter heifers - No reported sales. Confirmed - None Last Week - 500 Last Year - 400 For The Week - 200 Sm Pd Lst Wk - 1,900 Sm Pd Lst Yr - 500
